newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt chemical firm raises 95/6 dividend.
newsitem.headline: Egypt chemical firm raises 95/6 dividend.

text.p: Kima/Egyptian Chemical Industries said on Monday it would give shareholders a 1.10 pound dividend for the 1995/6 financial year, up from 0.905 pounds in 1994/5.
The firm's equity is distributed among eight million shares and some of these shares are traded on the Egyptian stock exchange. Company officials were not available to give any more details.
The firm's published financial results showed that 1995/6 pre-tax profits rose to 26.334 million pounds ($7.74 million) from 21.191 million pounds in the previous year.
But net distributable profits fell in 95/6 to 19.596 million from 19.639 million in 94/5.
The firm's shares are rarely traded on the stock exchange and last closed on December 30 at 12.50 pounds.
